programme.title: Ghostville
programme.desc: When the living choose to seek communication with the souls of the dead, tempt fate by calling forth spirits in a state of unrest, tread where fear is sure to follow, they may find that all roads lead to Ghostville.

programme.title: Canada's Most Haunted
programme.desc: Frightening paranormal activity abounds in the Great White North. From mansions to sea ports, Canada has as much haunted history as Europe and America combined. Prepare for an exciting thrill ride to some of Canada's most haunted locations.

programme.title: 2020 Nostradamus
programme.desc: Nostradamus predicted the rise of Hitler, the nuclear destruction of Hiroshima and 9/11. New research reveals further predictions that indicate more peril is on the horizon.

programme.title: Better Criminal
programme.desc: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

programme.title: Tai Chi Zero
programme.desc: Yang has arrived to learn, only to find that their Tai Chi is forbidden to outsiders. A mysterious man arrives with a fearsome machine, having to put their faith in Yang for help.

programme.title: The Ex-Files
programme.desc: Nick and Amanda both want Dr. Julian Heller's head -- as does Nick's ex-wife -- for selling human organs on the black market.

programme.title: The Frame
programme.desc: Amanda and Nick are accused of stealing a $20 million painting and meet up with another Immortal while trying to clear their names.

programme.title: Solum
programme.desc: A reality show on an uninhabited island where eight contestants must fight for their survival becomes more than it appears to be. Solum is not just a game -- it's a test, a selection process, and a mirror that confronts the truth of Human Nature, with the falsehoods of Mankind.

programme.title: Death Knot
programme.desc: Hari and her sister return to the village where they were born after the death of their mother, a practitioner of black magic. But the inexplicable suicides of several villagers cause the hostility towards the two to explode.

programme.title: Old Strangers
programme.desc: Three friends reconnect in a secluded mountain town after a long quarantine. While out for a hike, the trio stumble upon something dark and terrible in the deep woods.

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: Evil Eyes
programme.desc: In the vein of Stephen King's THE SHINING, EVIL EYES tells the story of a screenwriter who is hired by an eccentric producer to write a screenplay about a ruthless serial killer. As he works on the script, devising unique and terryifying ways for his characters to die, similar deaths seem to be happening to the people around him.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: Already in the throes of a viral pandemic, a massive polar vortex threatens to cover nearly all of Earth in ice. When it's discovered the only chance of survival from the cold is a 100-mile temperate zone near the equator, a virologist, with the pandemic's only cure, must reach the safe zone within 24 hours if humanity is to have any hope of survival.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: A couple and their daughter move to Colombia to take over a family manufacturing plant, only to realize their new home is haunted.

programme.title: Open 24 Hours
programme.desc: A former mental patient lands the graveyard shift at a gas station, where the isolation triggers her condition, bringing gruesome results.

programme.title: Vietnam! Vietnam!
programme.desc: Inspired by a series of articles by Thomas Duggan Goss. Vietnam:The People and the War - The Vietnamese in their normal daily routine. Their lives when having been affected by insurgents. Wives of prisoners of war in Vietnam talking about their incessant activities on behalf of their husband's plights.

programme.title: Skull World
programme.desc: Follows two years in the life of Greg Sommer, aka Skull Man, as he builds the Canadian chapter of Box Wars, an international underground movement of cardboard-based combat.

programme.title: Demons
programme.desc: A young rock band visits a deserted house to record their new album but things take a nightmarish turn when their Satanist manager attempts to open the gates of Hell.

programme.title: White Haired Witch
programme.desc: Based on one of China's most popular novels, the White Haired Witch tells a gripping story of kung fu, fantasy, revenge and death.

programme.title: The Beyond
programme.desc: Astronauts modified with advanced robotics are sent through a newly discovered wormhole. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their groundbreaking interstellar journey.

programme.title: D-Railed
programme.desc: Passengers on a train that crashes into a river must decide whether to risk waiting for help in the wreckage or take their chances in the murky depths below.

programme.title: Playhouse
programme.desc: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

programme.title: They Look Like People
programme.desc: Suspecting that those around him are actually malevolent shape-shifters, a troubled man questions whether to protect his only friend from an impending war, or from himself.

programme.title: Undergods
programme.desc: An otherworldly journey through a Europe in decline - a collection of darkly humorous, fantasy tales about ill-fated characters and doomed fortune.

programme.title: Killer Therapy
programme.desc: After a series of violent incidents, Brian is moved from failed therapist to failed therapist, maturing into a young man unable to escape his anger issues. Brian blames his therapists, and takes revenge on everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western "Traded", a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: The Boat
programme.desc: A lone sailor is locked inside the head of a sailboat that is underway -- and on autopilot.

programme.title: Will I Be Accepted?
programme.desc: As freedom looms for some and time stretches for others, one question lingers in the minds of the inmates in Institution A4 - will I be accepted?

programme.title: Michael David Dunn
programme.desc: In a racially charged shooting that fueled the BLM movement, the police desperately try to prove that 17-year-old Jordan Davis was not shot in an act of self-defense but cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: One Crime Can Hide Another
programme.desc: In the tranquil environs of Saint-Thomas-de-Conac, the discovery of a charred Mercedes and a gruesome cadaver initiated a perplexing investigation.

programme.title: Sharon Siermans
programme.desc: 29-year-old Ballarat mum Sharon Siermans sought love online and met Jason Godfrey in January 2013. When he arrived at the train station looking nothing like his photos, Sharon, embarrassed, made the disastrous choice to invite him to her home.

programme.title: Ruth Ellis
programme.desc: In 1955, London nightclub manager Ruth Ellis confesses to the murder of her abusive lover, then becomes the last woman to be executed in Britain.

programme.title: The Beast of Birkenshaw
programme.desc: Peter Manuel was a Scottish serial killer who killed at least eight people between 1956 -1958 around the Greater Glasgow area in Scotland.

programme.title: False Pretense
programme.desc: More than a year after the death of Harmonie Marin, her boyfriend is arrested and accused of her murder.

programme.title: Michael David Dunn
programme.desc: In a racially charged shooting that fueled the BLM movement, the police desperately try to prove that 17-year-old Jordan Davis was not shot in an act of self-defense but cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Drunkest Arrests
programme.desc: Inebriated suspects learn liquor and the law don't mix.

programme.title: Lawless Ladies 2
programme.desc: A revolt at a women's prison leaves guards at the mercy of the inmates; a police officer making a traffic stop is exposed to a topless revue; a woman with outstanding warrants adds assault on an officer to her rap sheet.

programme.title: Body at the Dock
programme.desc: A body is found floating at a dock in a North Florida creek; police initially suspect a motive of robbery, but the victim's complex love life suggests otherwise.

programme.title: Cuyahoga Falls Mystery
programme.desc: December 1987 in Ohio, the nude body of 17-year-old Barbara Blatnik is found face down on a rural road. She had been violently raped and strangled.

programme.title: A Killing in Kansas
programme.desc: In 1989, 20-year-old Krista Martin is murdered by an intruder in Wichita, Kansas. After a 40-year investigation, will investigative genetic genealogy provide answers for her family?

programme.title: Falling in Love Again
programme.desc: In Livermore, California, a love triangle sets two women on a collision course, while a couple rekindles romance by returning to a picturesque region of Michigan - but only one of them is returning home.

programme.title: Whodunnit?
programme.desc: In St. Michaels, Maryland, a real body turns up after a murder mystery dinner, and in Adelaide, South Australia, a love rival winds up dead.

programme.title: Love to Loathe
programme.desc: In New Port Richey, Florida, a sex party has a gruesome ending, while on the outskirts of London, England, farmyard animals could hold the key to what's happened to a missing wife.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: In Denver, Colorado, a mistress plots revenge when she's dumped, and in a small community north of Stockholm, Sweden, a deeply religious woman believes she's receiving messages from God - to kill.

programme.title: Bike Stop Pursuit
programme.desc: Berkeley County officers respond to a reported fight in progress; a bicycle traffic stop in Lee County turns into a foot chase; Richland County officers investigate a burglary in progress; Clayton County officers find meth during a traffic stop.

programme.title: Wild Goose Chase
programme.desc: The race is on for a fugitive who has several addresses before he fugitive flees the state. The Bounty Hunters are in Alabama searching for a fugitive that has expressed his hate for the police and has vowed to not give up without a fight.

programme.title: Florida Man
programme.desc: The Bounty Hunters crash a large party to apprehend a spousal abusing husband. The Bounty Hunters scour the streets of West Palm Beach searching for a fugitive wanted for assault and dealing drugs.

programme.title: The Insidious In-Law
programme.desc: In 1987, Kathy Odom was stabbed. DNA from a lamp cord, a new technique 15 years later, linked her brother-in-law, Greg Markwardt, to the murder.

programme.title: Carly Ryan
programme.desc: Carly Ryan thought she'd found her dream boy in 18-year-old musician Brandon Kane. They chatted online for 18 months under her mother's watch. Unbeknownst to them, both Brandon and his stepfather were personas created by 50-year-old Garry Newman.

programme.title: The Campus Killer
programme.desc: Katherine Foster found shot at UA. Campus guard suspected, then cleared. Cold case reopens 20 years later after confession by a friend during AA.

programme.title: William Howell
programme.desc: William Devin Howell was responsible for the disappearance of women. Opioid addicts, desperate for their next fix, turned to sex to survive, but were seen by a man with an addiction of his own.

programme.title: Cry for Help
programme.desc: Lawyer's drunk daughter tries to cry her way out of a DUI.

programme.title: Lights Out
programme.desc: Drunk woman literally knocks the lights out on New Jersey street.

programme.title: Amanda Knox
programme.desc: Within weeks of moving to Perugia, Italy, Amanda Knox is charged with her roommate's bloody murder. Amanda and her boyfriend are jailed for the crime and the national media goes wild with speculation.

programme.title: Surviving Prison
programme.desc: How do inmates survive within the strict confines of Singapore's only women's prison?

programme.title: Marvin Williams
programme.desc: Vivica examines the murder of Cassandra Valentin by her fiance Marvin Williams. Williams and Valentin had begun dating in 2004 but their relationship quickly became violent.

programme.title: Deadly Jog
programme.desc: A 34 year old mother is found murdered at the side of the road.

programme.title: Nadine Aburas
programme.desc: In 2012, Cardiff's Nadine Aburas met New Yorker Sammy Almahri on a Muslim dating site. Their intense online relationship led to Nadine visiting New York in July 2014. However, once there, she discovered a different, troubling side to him.

programme.title: Knock. Talk. Enter. Kill.
programme.desc: An unsolved shooting in 2003 is linked to two similar murders, a decade later. Ballistics evidence links all three to an unusual bullet type - and even more unusual murder weapons. Law enforcement tracks down an unlikely serial killer: a man who had run for mayor and congress.

programme.title: The Black Widow
programme.desc: Nineteenth-century serial killer Mary Ann Cotton, aka the Black Widow, travels around northeast England and murders men for their life insurance.

programme.title: The Jigsaw Murders
programme.desc: Dr Ruxton accused his wife of infidelity for years but in September 1935 Ruxton's jealousy got the better of him.

programme.title: Deady Vengeance
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of 2 years-old Méline is found in her home. Her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: Marvin Williams
programme.desc: Vivica examines the murder of Cassandra Valentin by her fiance Marvin Williams. Williams and Valentin had begun dating in 2004 but their relationship quickly became violent.

programme.title: Entitled Suspects
programme.desc: "Untouchable" suspects square off with police.

programme.title: Citizens Under Attack
programme.desc: A jilted husband savagely stabs his wife; a strip club bouncer goes berserk and beats a customer; a feisty woman in a miniskirt goes toe-to-toe with a gang of bullies.

programme.title: Sunk in the Lake
programme.desc: A drought at a French lake reveals a sunken Toyota holding the body of a U.K. expat who's been missing for two years; her controlling husband becomes police's prime suspect.

programme.title: Terror in Texas
programme.desc: In 1983, the Seabrook, Texas community is shaken when 20-year-old waitress Susan Eads is found murdered. Decades later, can modern forensic techniques finally find the perpetrator?

programme.title: Dark Minds
programme.desc: In Chicago, Illinois, a millionaire meets an exotic dancer with a secret agenda, and in Marion, Ohio, friends suspect the worst when a wife and mother goes missing.

programme.title: Stranger Danger
programme.desc: An internet love triangle leads to deception and murder near Buffalo, New York. On the outskirts of London, England, a romantic stroll through the woods ends with a brutal attack.

programme.title: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: In Goode, Virginia, a 50-year age gap proves a nightmare for a wealthy retired businessman and his violent girlfriend. In Austin, Texas, a millionaire wakes up and thinks his stomach has torn apart - but then discovers he's been shot.

programme.title: Momma Knows Best
programme.desc: In Merrillville, Indiana, there are deadly secrets between family members, while near Manchester, England, a late night flower delivery proves a test run for murder.

programme.title: Aim to Maim
programme.desc: In Kansas City, Missouri, a married woman falls for a street hustler and pays a devastating price. In Castlerock, Northern Ireland, a married dentist falls for a patient, and comes up with an unusual treatment plan to secure a fresh start.

programme.title: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: In Lebanon, Maine, an estranged wife trying to start a new life can't escape her violent past, while in Vincennes, Indiana, a married engineer falls for the babysitter and leads her on a downward path...to murder.

programme.title: Stolen Rental Car
programme.desc: Officers pursue a man who fled on foot; officers stop a reckless driver; officers investigate a stolen rental car; officers catch a man exposing himself.

programme.title: In Cognito
programme.desc: The fugitive is woken up by Bounty Hunters who have located where he is hiding. After changing her name, bleaching her hair, and changing her appearance to look like a man, the fugitive still cannot escape the Bounty Hunters.

programme.title: Just When He Thought It Was Safe
programme.desc: Our Bounty Hunters search the trailer park for this fugitive who's jumped bail on a Meth Trafficking charge. Our Agents pursue a fugitive who has violated his probation and also skipped bail.

programme.title: Nice Guys Finish Last
programme.desc: Trenton Mallory and fiance Amber Smith of Levering, Michigan have had their ups and downs in recent years. Things finally seem to be on the upswing when 'Trading Trent' as he is known because of his hobby of buying and selling guns is found shot in his bed while still asleep.

programme.title: The Monster Among Us
programme.desc: The story of 17-year-old Thomas Griffiths, who killed his girlfriend and arranged the crime scene to look like a suicide.

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So, his mission continues.

programme.title: Murder of Angie Young
programme.desc: A 36-year-old mother was gunned down in a restaurant parking lot, leaving detectives searching for answers. Through relentless police work, investigators uncovered the sinister details behind the carefully orchestrated attack.

programme.title: Shoplifting Haul
programme.desc: Woman blames racism for shoplifting haul at sporting goods store.

programme.title: Cry for Help
programme.desc: Lawyer's drunk daughter tries to cry her way out of a DUI.

programme.title: Body Overboard
programme.desc: A woman's husband reports her falling overboard into Lake Erie, but police don't buy his story.

programme.title: In Losing It
